name: Pritika Engineering Components Ltd.
summary: Pritika Engineering Components Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing of precision machined components for the automotive industry. The company's primary products, derived from iron castings and forgings, include a range of critical parts such as rear axle housings, differential cases, hydraulic lift covers, wheel hubs, front engine and axle supports, flywheel housings, and transmission covers. These components are designed for applications in tractors, commercial vehicles, and material handling equipment. Pritika Engineering Components Ltd. primarily serves Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) within the tractor and automotive sectors, with notable clients including major tractor manufacturers. The company operates manufacturing facilities in North India, utilizing integrated foundry and machining capabilities to produce customized components.
